text: わたしは　ひとりで　いたいんだ　でて　いって　くれ！

structure.jp: ひとりで　いたいんだ
structure.en: want to be alone, you see

structure.jp: でて　いって　くれ！

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.span: でて　いって　くれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form is a blunt, male way of telling someone to do something for you. でて　いって　くれ = 'get out'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end of a statement gives it an explaining, insisting tone; んだ is its spoken form. いたいんだ = 'I want to be, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it; here it is on いる 'to be', not the word for 'painful'. ひとりで　いたい = 'I want to be alone'.
